caption:
Hybi's Weekly Recap for Nov 23–28 is here.

Short on time? Exercise snacks like 10 squats while the kettle boils are a simple start. Long hours on the mouse? Open and close your fists 10 times and keep your elbows about desk height. When it's hot, move sessions to early morning or evening and go by effort, not pace. Leg pain when walking that eases when you sit? Walk until it builds, sit 1–2 minutes, repeat.

Scroll back through this week's posts for the full comics. Book online via the link in bio 🐰
